story.iWant: a centralized ARCHESController that manages query session lifecycle, plan state, and memory usage
story.soThat: I can prevent redundant agent calls and coordinate ARCHES components through shared state

tasks.task: Create ARCHES module structure - src/jarvis/arches/__init__.py and controller.py
Implement ARCHESSession dataclass with session_id, query, plan_state, memory_state, agent_results, flags
Implement ARCHESController class with start_session(), should_trigger_research(), record_memory_usage()
Integrate controller into chat.py and query.py as session manager

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: ARCHESController class instantiated per-query session with unique session_id
Tracks plan_state with stages: assess, research, critical, hybrid, execute, store
Records memory_state: chunks_used, domains, freshness_scores, retrieved_at
Maintains state flags: is_research_triggered, fallback_needed, rerun_detected
should_trigger_research() checks session state before gap analysis
Controller integrated into chat.py and query.py as session manager
Real-time freshness scores computed for retrieved memory chunks

doc.title: Epic 4.5: ARCHES Cognitive Stabilization
doc.snippet: Introduces central arches/controller.py holding full plan state, memory state, and session tracking. Transforms ARCHES from pattern to controller.

doc.title: Jarvis Architecture
doc.snippet: ARCHES: Assess, Research, Critical, Hybrid, Execute, Store - distributed cognitive pattern for query processing.
